memoryScope: WASM linear memory only; excludes JS heap and compiled code.
scope: Actual published Temporal namespace. Default TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar data/arithmetic, host Intl Umm al-Qura and named timezones. WASM delegates ISO/Instant/PlainTime/calendar/timezone/Duration math, plain/zoned/short-date arithmetic, string parsing and date formatting with16 native calendars and all IANA records; object semantics and host/Intl integration remain JS/TS. Native-data profile removes duplicated TS calendar/IANA tables; hybrid retains compact TS calendars. ISO date and zoned workloads use basic reference; no non-ISO throughput claim. Transition cases use explicit per-case counts. References temporal-polyfill1.0.7 basic and @js-temporal/polyfill0.5.1. Binary WASM operations return complete records with cached derived fields; JS retains observable object/coercion/option semantics.
method: Fresh sequential processes for current pure TS and native-data WASM. All 48 workloads, eight varying inputs/parity, 20000 warmup and 9x50000 calls (transitions:1000 warmup,9x5000). Unchanged pinned temporal-polyfill and @js-temporal/polyfill timings retained from zoned-parse-hillclimb-results.json (originally instant-hillclimb-results.json). Hybrid throughput omitted. No profiler. Production stripped WASM. Browser export-all consumer size; Node namespace payload/startup measured separately.
